findings.evidence: float("nan") parses successfully, so max(0.0, float("nan")) returns 0.0 and the client retries immediately rather than using the documented existing backoff for malformed headers ("inf" is handled, "nan" is not); impact is one extra request, bounded by max_retries
findings.title: Retry-After 'nan' yields a zero delay instead of the backoff fallback
